title: Direct and Indirect Speech: Yes or No Questions — Quiz 130

## Direct and Indirect Speech: Yes or No Questions

Use if or whether to report questions that have a yes or no answer.

### Lesson focus

1. I said to a class student, “Do you like online classes?”
2. A tourist said to a local, “Is there any good hotel here?”

### Practise with the image

Read the full lesson image for the original exercise, notes and any answer key shown. Write your own answers before checking a key. A key labelled for another quiz belongs to that quiz.
